buildings.note: base H2->D2 conversion 1% of belt throughput; proliferated H2 raises it by the speedup bonus; work power scales with output above 18 D/min

buildings.name: Advanced Mining Machine
buildings.note: 60 items/min per covered vein (2x Mining Machine); periodf=1

buildings.name: Water Pump
buildings.note: 50/min * mining speed multiplier; periodf=1.2

buildings.name: Oil Extractor
buildings.note: output = crude oil seep base rate * mining speed multiplier (seep rate decays with 12h half-life, min 0.1/s)

buildings.name: Orbital Collector
buildings.note: raw rate = GG base yield * 8 * mining speed; 30 MW upkeep is paid from the collected H2/D2 (9 MJ each) so ~200 units/min is consumed

miningConstants.miningSpeedMultiplierFormula: miningSpeedMultiplier = 1 + 0.10 * VeinUtilizationLevel (applies to Mining Machine, Advanced Mining Machine, Water Pump, Oil Extractor and Orbital Collector gathering speed)
miningConstants.veinConsumptionFormula: vein units consumed per item = 0.94 ^ VeinUtilizationLevel; total ore obtainable from a vein = initialAmount / 0.94^level
miningConstants.notes: Vein Utilization adds +10% mining speed additively per level and reduces vein consumption by 6% compounding per level, so total available ore rises as 1/0.94^n while the depletion rate peaks at level 6 and falls below the level-0 rate at level 17. The rate is the SAME for every material vein type (both the EN and the zh-CN wiki state this explicitly). CONFLICT: VeinProtoSet.MiningTime differs per ore (stone 45, coal 30, iron/copper/silicon/titanium/crude 60, kimberlite/fractal/grating/stalagmite 90, unipolar magnet 120); if the machine used it the rates would differ, so MiningTime is judged to drive hand-mining / mecha mining rather than machine throughput - chosen: flat 30/min/vein. Miners covering more than 1800/min auto-stack their output (2 stacks at >1800/min, 3 at >3600/min, 4 at >5400/min).
